description: Defines the rlc_tx_um_entity class and related structures for handling UM RLC transmission entities, including state management, buffer handling, and interface methods for higher and lower layers within a 3GPP LTE/NR protocol stack.

classes.name: rlc_tx_um_entity
classes.description: Represents a Unacknowledged Mode (UM) RLC transmission entity managing SDUs, PDU creation, buffer states, and interactions with protocol layers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all timers and marks the entity as stopped.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDUs from higher layers, with an indicator if it is a retransmission.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards an SDU identified by its PDCP sequence number.

methods.name: pull_pdu
methods.description: Retrieves a PDU for transmission to lower layers.

methods.name: get_buffer_state
methods.description: Returns the current buffer state of the entity.

methods.name: get_si_and_expected_header_size
methods.description: Calculates signaling information and header size based on current state and grant.

methods.name: handle_changed_buffer_state
methods.description: Defers notification of buffer state changes to the executor.

methods.name: update_mac_buffer_state
methods.description: Immediately updates the MAC layer with the current buffer state.

methods.name: log_state
methods.description: Logs the current state of the entity.
